title: AI Overview Capture Registry — EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v12.167 — 633 semantic addresses, 811 captures, 2026-06-07 to 2026-10-12
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Versioned snapshot of the AI Overview Capture Registry (EA-WG-CAPTURES-01) at v12.167, continuing the deposit chain from v6.0 through v10.9 (#1461), which it supersedes. A longitudinal instrument for recording dated machine-mediated reception events: what composition layers make of a named entity when asked for it at a specific semantic address, on a specific date, in a specific authentication state. 633 semantic addresses carry 811 captures across 84 dates; 792 carry a verbatim transcript and 328 a frame; 505 are scored for Provenance Erasure Rate, at a mean of 0.506 (0.603 at v10.9). Surfaces: Google AI Overview 490, ChatGPT across its recorded labels 167, Google AI Mode 12, Grok 7, Bing Copilot 6, Perplexity 5, Claude 3, Qwen 2, Google Knowledge panel 2, seven single-capture surfaces, and 110 whose surface is undetermined, unresolved or unrecorded. The core data travels as one bundle with its SHA-256; the 469 capture frames are manifested at their canonical paths rather than duplicated. Known defects are recorded as data, not repaired.
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate). Snapshot assembled, counted and written in session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction, from the canonical store at v12.167. The captures themselves were taken by the operator on the surfaces named in each record.
methodology: Each capture records the exact issued string, the surface, the date, the authentication state, the evidence class (paste, frame, or both), the returned source strip rendered as chips with each chip's relation to the archive (archive-controlled, authored surface, third party), a verbatim transcript where obtainable, and the finding. Surfaces are taken from operator attestation, with the frame as corroboration; a session is logged where it began. Match type and Provenance Erasure Rate are recorded per capture, never per address. A capture enters by source engagement in composition; a later non-engagement at an address already seated enters as a longitudinal observation of that address. Intake adds and is safe; repair touches an existing record and runs in its own mode and its own commit. Each batch of intake is kept with the pastes as received, the operator's message and the script that authored each capture, in which every quotation and figure a finding rests on is asserted against the seated deposit text before anything is written. Counts in this record are computed from data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json at v12.167.
falsification_conditions: Any capture is falsified by a rerun at the same address, surface, authentication state and date that returns materially different composition, which is why the exact issued string and the rerun URL are recorded. The snapshot is falsified if the attached bundle's SHA-256 does not match, or if any manifested file's SHA-256 does not match the file at its stated path. A PER score is falsified by a source strip, or a set of retained markers, inconsistent with the recorded value; section 7 lists the twelve scores that already fail this test.
axn_reading: Foundation -> Proof -> Growth -> Force -> Growth -> Method
wiki_article:
**AI Overview Capture Registry — EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v12.167** is a versioned snapshot of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's longitudinal reception instrument, deposited by Lee Sharks on 12 October 2026. It supersedes v10.9 (#1461). It records 633 semantic addresses carrying 811 dated captures across 84 dates, spanning 7 June to 12 October 2026.

The registry documents what machine composition layers make of a named entity when asked for it at a specific semantic address, on a specific date, in a specific authentication state. Each capture records the exact issued string, the surface, the evidence class, the returned source strip with each source's relation to the archive, a verbatim transcript where obtainable, a match type and a Provenance Erasure Rate. 792 captures carry a transcript and 328 a frame; 505 are PER-scored at a mean of 0.506, against 0.603 at v10.9.

**The citable unit is the capture — one surface, one semantic address, one date.** Each address has had its own page since 25 September 2026, and is the right unit when a claim concerns the address rather than one system's behaviour.

Between v10.9 and this edition the instrument changed in five ways. The canonical store moved from the rebuild file to the projection (`data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json`) on 17 August, and the rebuild store was sealed. ChatGPT grew from 3 captures to 167, and Grok, Perplexity, Claude and Qwen entered. Source chips became data. A coverage audit (#1614) made the transcript count monotone. And on 12 October, 43 deposits were captured at their own record pages' Ask ChatGPT prompts, signed out: the author was retained in all 43, the archive in 27 and the identifier in 22.

The core data is attached as an 18.7 MB bundle with a SHA-256. Its 469 capture frames are manifested at their canonical paths rather than duplicated. Known defects — two addresses declaring more observations than they hold, twelve PER scores inconsistent with their markers, four captures with no surface recorded — are listed in the record and not repaired, since repair runs in its own mode.
